summary.headline: Driver update article removes workplace-joined limitations section

summary.headline: Feature update status and report wording refreshed
summary.summary: The feature updates article standardizes status formatting, clarifies that a user logon starts the initial USO scan for Last Scanned Time, and generalizes Windows 10/11 reporting text to Windows devices.
summary.adminImpact: Expect Not scanned yet until a user logs on and a USO scan starts.

summary.headline: Settings catalog article refreshed

summary.headline: Quality update overview adds Hotpatch description
summary.summary: The Windows updates overview simplifies the policy list and specifies that quality updates include monthly security and reliability updates, expedited updates, and Hotpatch for eligible security patches without reboot.
summary.adminImpact: Assess Hotpatch eligibility separately when planning quality update policy deployment.

summary.headline: Feature update migration report link updated

summary.adminImpact: Verify devices are OfferReady in the current report before proceeding with migration.

summary.headline: Update ring settings links removed from limitations list
summary.summary: The update rings article replaces links in its unsupported-setting list with plain setting names: pause, feature deferral, uninstall period, and pre-release builds.

summary.headline: HoloLens UpdateServiceUrl link updated
summary.summary: The Windows Holographic UpdateServiceUrl custom-setting guidance now links to the Windows updates index.
summary.adminImpact: No setting behavior change.

summary.headline: iOS LOB app guidance clarifies duplicate bundle-ID risk
summary.summary: The article clarifies that multiple Intune app instances can share a bundle ID but targeting separate instances can create unexpected device behavior; beta and production apps need different bundle identifiers.
summary.adminImpact: Use distinct bundle IDs for beta and production iOS LOB apps, and avoid targeting duplicate app instances.

summary.headline: Windows update overview refreshes Autopatch explanation
summary.summary: The overview describes Autopatch as an Intune-integrated service that orchestrates existing policies and adds dynamic grouping, phased rollout, health monitoring, compliance reporting, Hotpatch, and expedited delivery; its comparison table is reformatted.
summary.adminImpact: Do not assign custom update rings to Autopatch-managed devices as documented.

summary.headline: Windows updates index redirect formatting adjusted
summary.summary: A formatting-only block was added to the Windows updates index as part of redirect maintenance.
summary.adminImpact: No configuration change.
